g.text: - IC611 TLC277 is powered between pin 8 (~0.78 kohm in-circuit to VGATE; exact feed not traced) and the negative rail VNEG (pin 4, C230).

g.desc: - IC611 TLC277 is powered between pin 8 (~0.78 kohm in-circuit to VGATE; exact feed not traced) and the negative rail VNEG (pin 4, C230).

g.text: - Half A converts the T700 secondary current to a voltage (300 ohm in, 68 kohm // C feedback, D700/D701 clamp). Where CT_P is referenced and where output A goes were not traced.

g.desc: - Half A converts the T700 secondary current to a voltage (300 ohm in, 68 kohm // C feedback, D700/D701 clamp). Where CT_P is referenced and where output A goes were not traced.

g.text: - Half B amplifies the shunt voltage (LS_EMIT) for the MCU (pin 29). IC610 output A is the hardware overcurrent trip; output B goes to unpopulated pads (second trip, not fitted).

g.desc: - Half B amplifies the shunt voltage (LS_EMIT) for the MCU (pin 29). IC610 output A is the hardware overcurrent trip; output B goes to unpopulated pads (second trip, not fitted).

g.text: - CN502: pin 1 motor NTC (~12.5 kohm at room temperature, i.e. a 10 kohm NTC); pins 2/3 rotor-position sensors; pin 4 sensor supply; pin 5 GND.

g.desc: - CN502: pin 1 motor NTC (~12.5 kohm at room temperature, i.e. a 10 kohm NTC); pins 2/3 rotor-position sensors; pin 4 sensor supply; pin 5 GND.
